{"path": "imu.py", "content": "from board import *
import adafruit_icm20x as icm
i2c = I2C(scl, sda)
# WHO_AM_I (reg 0x70) reads 0xEA -> ICM-20948.
imu = icm.ICM20948(i2c, address=0x69)
print(imu.acceleration)
"}

text: Fixed: WHO_AM_I value 0xEA (read from register 0x70) is an ICM-20948, not the MPU6050-class part the code assumed. The old driver read nonexistent registers on this device, hence zero accel. Switched to the adafruit_icm20x ICM20948 driver.
